progress_guide_title: How your progress is computed — PyDA Course
progress_guide_description: Every XP rule, level formula, rank threshold, quest, and improvement-report metric, documented from the source code.
progress_guide_intro: Your progress page is built from one transparent "player card" — a single progress state kept in this browser. Everything below documents exactly how each number is derived, straight from the code that computes it.
progress_guide_storage_intro: All progress — XP, lessons, quizzes, streaks, quests, badges, and a full activity log — is stored in your browser's local storage under a single key (`pda:state`).
progress_guide_storage_body: It never leaves your device: there is no account, no server, and no leaderboard. The activity log keeps the last 200 actions and is rendered on the progress page so you can see exactly what earned what. Badges are flat labels appended as you hit quests and milestones.
progress_guide_xp_intro: Every action earns fixed XP, capped at 9,999 total:
progress_guide_xp_run_note: running a cell in any lesson, the playground, or a challenge
progress_guide_xp_pcomplete_note: finishing a whole guided project — more than a single lesson
progress_guide_xp_qcorrect_note: each right answer in a lesson quiz
progress_guide_xp_qperfect_note: getting every question right in one quiz
progress_guide_xp_daily_note: opening the site on a new day
progress_guide_xp_sbonus_note: extra per day once your streak passes day 3
progress_guide_xp_milestone_note: auto-awarded when you cross an XP/quest milestone
progress_guide_level_intro: Level uses a curved formula so early progress always feels rewarding:
progress_guide_level_note: Level 10 lands around 1,500 XP, Level 20 around 4,500, Level 30 around 8,500.
progress_guide_streak_intro: A streak counts consecutive days you open the site.
progress_guide_streak_inc: Coming back today keeps it; returning yesterday-tomorrow advances it by 1; skipping a day resets it to 1. Your best streak is always remembered.
progress_guide_streak_bonus: From day 3 on, each day adds a 15 XP streak bonus on top of your daily login, and streak milestones (3/7/14/30 days) pay a 30 XP bonus.
progress_guide_quest_intro: Quests are milestones that unlock automatically — there is nothing to claim. They cover:
progress_guide_quest_firsts: firsts (first run, first lesson, first project, first step)
progress_guide_quest_tracks: tracks (finish all of Python 101 or Data Analysis)
progress_guide_report_intro: Once you've finished a lesson, your progress page shows a game-style after-action report comparing your own numbers to a published visual-novel course study.
progress_guide_report_winrate_note: your quiz accuracy — correct answers ÷ questions answered
progress_guide_report_kda_note: kills = quiz answers right, deaths = quiz answers wrong, assists = lessons completed
progress_guide_report_activity_note: days active, lessons per week, average XP per day, and a consistency score mixing your streak and lesson pace
progress_guide_report_engagement_note: return rate, current streak length, and your longest session
progress_guide_report_diag_note: progress %, a study-aligned N-Gain equivalent, motivation acceptance, usefulness (accuracy), and learning experience
progress_guide_report_study_post: , a visual-novel-based computing course measured with N-Gain 0.61 and 87.6% acceptance.
progress_guide_report_footnote: Your report labels a diagnostic band (Rookie → Legend) from your K/D/A ratio, and is gated: it only appears after your first completed lesson. Everything is computed from your own activity.
